from __future__ import annotations

from .cart import Cart

BULK_THRESHOLD = 10
BULK_DISCOUNT_PERCENT = 5


def bulk_discount_cents(cart: Cart) -> int:
    """Five percent off every line with at least ten units."""
    eligible = [item for item in cart.items if item.quantity >= BULK_THRESHOLD]
    rate = BULK_DISCOUNT_PERCENT
    discount = sum(item.price_cents * item.quantity * rate // 100 for item in eligible)
    return discount


def total_after_discounts_cents(cart: Cart) -> int:
    return max(cart.subtotal_cents() - bulk_discount_cents(cart), 0)
